subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Courageous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Gutsy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Courageous"** means having the ability to face danger, pain, or difficult situations without fear; being brave. (साहसी)

 
 
• **Example:** The **courageous **firefighter entered the burning building to save the trapped residents.
 
 
 
• **"Gutsy"** refers to someone who shows courage, determination, and boldness. (साहसी)
 
 
• **Example:** Her **gutsy **decision to start her own business despite the risks paid off in the end.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Courageous'** is **'Gutsy'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Timid** (डरपोक): Showing a lack of courage or confidence; easily frightened.

 
 
• **Example:** The **timid **child was afraid to speak in front of the class.
 
 
 
• **Fearful** (भयभीत): Feeling or showing fear or anxiety.
 
 
• **Example:** She was **fearful **of the thunderstorm that raged outside.
 
 
 
• **Cowardly** (कायर): Lacking courage; excessively afraid of danger or pain.
 
 
• **Example:** The soldier was accused of being **cowardly **for abandoning his post.
